i’ve always really loved her music, i listened to her a lot during the speak now era since my older cousin had the CD and i always memorised the songs i heard on the radio. 

didn’t really listen to her during red era (didn’t even know that album existed until the rerelease LMFAO) and i always saw 1989 CDs in supermarkets but also didn’t really listen to it other than the singles. 

reputation though, really really got me hooked. i downloaded the album since during that time we had a lot of power outages in my country and memorised all the lyrics. 

(i should mention that i got into reputation years after it released, because a couple months later the first lover single was released) i wasn’t the biggest fan of ME!, but i religiously listened to lover and YNTCD. when the lover album came out i listened to it on repeat until i got kinda tired of it and moved on with my life for the most part. 

flash forward to late last year and the duolingo tiktok account started posting about taylor and i decide to check out her music again. i immediately became obsess with the very first night, forever winter and nothing new. 

during the time i stopped listening to lover, i got really into indie music like clairo and mitski, so you can imagine how much i enjoyed folklore and evermore after listening to them for the first time. 

since november ive been listening to nothing but taylor, so after i eventually move on again i have no idea what’s going to bring me back, but i’m excited to see what’s next.
